name: veterinary_clinic_system_086_owner_statement_messages
instruction: Monthly statements: for every owner whose current balance is greater than 0, push one communications row {channel: 'email', direction: 'outbound', subject: 'Statement ready — balance $<balance with 2 decimals>', body: 'Your statement for <N> open invoice(s) is ready.
